name: Glacimyces tardus
story: Lives in frozen litter and grows a hair's width an hour. It is densest of all, branching at right angles into a tight mat, and stops entirely above 12 C. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the LIT family.
